author: Sfulzele
quote:
Waited over a decade for this and got the most restrictive GTA ever made. This series was built on chaos, and Rockstar sanded every edge off. You can't run over or shoot protesters. Trains slam on the brakes the second anything touches the track. Whole areas feel like the game is babysitting you. It's Grand Theft Auto with the theft and the auto taken out. 

Jason has zero spine. He follows Lucia around like a lapdog and never makes a decision of his own. Then the game keeps hinting that he's gay, and it feels less like character writing and more like Rockstar ticking a diversity box. Lucia is one of the most unlikable protagonists Rockstar has ever written: selfish, reckless, a terrible mother, and sleeping around behind everyone's back until she ends up with herpes. That subplot is cheap shock value, and the game still expects you to root for her.

You can feel daddy corporate's hands all over this. Somewhere a boardroom decided the biggest game of the decade needed to be a vehicle for their messaging, and the result is a GTA scared of offending anyone. The rebellious, anything-goes spirit that made this series legendary has been replaced by a corporate checklist. Every design choice feels like it went through a PR department first.

Gorgeous world, nothing to do in it. Hard pass. Biggest letdown in gaming history.
